# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Adjusted the source-water carbonate validator to accept the deliberate zero-DIC-with-buffer alkaline ceiling while still rejecting other clamp-boundary fallback profiles. The solver now tracks that zero-DIC buffered limit explicitly, reuses shared negligible-input thresholds, documents the validation exception in `chemistry.rs`, updates preset error wording, and adds regression coverage in both `tank_core` and `tank_data` so the boundary case stays valid without reopening the acid-crash/high-buffer source-water paths.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspect the remaining source-water carbonate validation inconsistency and confirm which solver and preset paths needed adjustment.
1. [Completed] Patch the carbonate validator to allow the intentional zero-DIC buffered alkaline limit while preserving rejection of other clamp-boundary source-water profiles, and align the surrounding comments and preset messaging.
2. [Completed] Add regression coverage for the zero-DIC buffered source-water case and rerun formatting, tests, and clippy across the affected crates.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test chemistry` passed (21 tests), including `source_water_validation_accepts_zero_dic_buffered_limit_case`.
- `cargo test -p tank_data --lib` passed (6 tests), including `source_water_preset_accepts_zero_dic_buffered_limit_case` and the existing out-of-range rejection coverage.
- `cargo test -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios` passed across the full workspace test suites.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `git status --short` after validation showed only the intended tracked edits in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/chemistry.rs`, and `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs`, plus the pre-existing unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory.

## Outstanding Risks

- `solve_carbonate_equilibrium()` still uses the freshwater-focused approximation with fixed `Ka2`, so any extension beyond the intended pH 5.5-8.5 aquarium envelope should revisit the chemistry model.
- Legacy saves with custom out-of-range source-water catalog entries still deserialize, but runtime water-change actions against those profiles fail validation until the profile is corrected.
- The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.
